Diagnosis: Ovarian Neoplasm
Evidence: The patient presents with a 1-month history of insidious-onset right lower abdominal pain and lifelong non-pitting edema of the left leg. Imaging findings reveal a large hypoechoic lesion in the right adnexa and a well-marginated thin-walled solid-cystic lesion in the abdominopelvic region, concerning for an ovarian neoplasm.
